name: SeedEngine
tagline: Suggests which crop genes are best to edit for a trait and outputs a short lab report.

awards: MLH || Best Use of Gemini API || Google Swag Kits

problem: Gene-editing strategy for crops needs specialist analysis.
solution: A pipeline pulls genomic and protein data, predicts structures and ranks editable genes for traits such as drought resistance, summarised by Gemini.
demo_moment: Team-described: request drought-resistant soybeans and read the report.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH || Best Use of Gemini API || Google Swag Kits” among 231 submissions.
A solo build over real biology databases.

lessons: Condense expert analysis into a one-page report.
